insight.description: Draws clear, evidence-based contrasts among platforms’ pricing and capabilities instead of presenting isolated product descriptions.
Explains how differences in pricing models and cost drivers relate to differences in platform capabilities, performance, or operational flexibility.
Interprets price differences using comparable usage or deployment assumptions and explains how changes in scale or workload could alter the comparison.
Reaches qualified conclusions about which platforms may suit different needs, making the trade-offs behind those judgments clear rather than declaring a universal winner.

readability.description: Presents platform comparisons with consistent labels and parallel formatting so readers can readily compare like with like.
Labels price figures and their units, billing bases, and qualifications unambiguously wherever they are presented.
Uses precise, consistent wording to distinguish platform capabilities without vague shorthand or confusingly similar labels.
Uses clear transitions, readable sentences, and headings or other signposts that make the discussion easy to follow.
